description: List measurement units. Optional: query (name filter, or similarity ranking if fuzzy search is on), limit, random. Returns {count, next, previous, results}, 50 per page.

format.description: slim (default) returns a compact shape. full returns the raw Tandoor object.

limit.description: Maximum number of units to return.

query.description: Name filter, or similarity ranking when Tandoor fuzzy search is on.

random.description: String. Any non-empty value shuffles the order, even "false".

updated_at.description: No effect: Tandoor units have no updated_at field.

name: list_units
title: List units
